en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Al Husayn Bin Abu Al A’ala who said,
‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the tooth-brushing. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes, he can brush teeth whichever time of the day he so desires to’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from al-Husayn ibn abu al-‘Ala’ who has said the following: “
I once asked abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a man who brushes his teeth when fasting. He (the Imam) said, ‘Yes, he can brush his teeth any time during the day.’”
